lines.text: Pharisees and scribes from Damascus gather around Jesus and see some disciples eating with unwashed hands.
The Pharisees and all the Jews wash their hands ceremonially before eating, and the Pharisees and scribes question Jesus.
Jesus quotes the prophet Isaiah and says they disregard the commandment of God to keep the tradition of men.
Jesus says Abraham commanded honoring father and mother, yet their Corban tradition nullifies the word of God.
Jesus teaches that food entering a man does not defile him, but evil coming from within his heart does.
